name: Immich
description: The closest thing to Synology Photos: automatic backup from your phone (iOS and Android app), timeline, albums and shared albums, face and place search, memories. Photos are stored in the 'immich' shared folder. Needs 4 GB of memory or more (6 GB recommended).
notes: Open it and create the admin account (the first account becomes the administrator). Phone app: search 'Immich' in the App Store / Google Play, server address http://${HOST}:2283. To show photos you already have, add an External Library in Administration with the path /mnt/photo (your 'photo' shared folder, read-only). Database password (you won't need it): ${SECRET}
compose:
services:
  immich-server:
    image: ghcr.io/immich-app/immich-server:v3
    restart: always
    ports:
      - "2283:2283"
    environment:
      - DB_PASSWORD=${SECRET}
      - DB_USERNAME=immich
      - DB_DATABASE_NAME=immich
      - TZ=${TZ}
    volumes:
      - ${SHARE:immich}:/data
      - ${SHARE:photo}:/mnt/photo:ro
      - /etc/localtime:/etc/localtime:ro
    depends_on:
      - redis
      - database
    healthcheck:
      disable: false
  immich-machine-learning:
    image: ghcr.io/immich-app/immich-machine-learning:v3
    restart: always
    environment:
      - MACHINE_LEARNING_MODEL_REVISION=v2
    volumes:
      - ./model-cache:/cache
    healthcheck:
      disable: false
  redis:
    image: docker.io/valkey/valkey:9@sha256:418652cfb58ef879d4978c33553735d7147016032d5aefaa14c828e611eb9dfd
    restart: always
    healthcheck:
      test: redis-cli ping | grep -q PONG || exit 1
  database:
    image: ghcr.io/immich-app/postgres:14-vectorchord0.4.3-pgvectors0.2.0@sha256:bcf63357191b76a916ae5eb93464d65c07511da41e3bf7a8416db519b40b1c23
    restart: always
    environment:
      - POSTGRES_PASSWORD=${SECRET}
      - POSTGRES_USER=immich
      - POSTGRES_DB=immich
      - POSTGRES_INITDB_ARGS=--data-checksums
    volumes:
      - ./postgres:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    shm_size: 128mb
    healthcheck:
      disable: false
